name: badge
title: Badge
description: A compact label with two independent axes: a visual treatment (solid, soft, outline, ghost, link) and a semantic tone for status color.
author: Design From <https://labs.designfrom.com>

props.name: variant
props.description: Selects the variant styles defined by badgeVariants.

props.name: tone
props.description: Selects the tone styles defined by badgeVariants.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render the single child element instead of the default element, merging props onto it (Radix Slot).

a11y: Renders an inline span, so its text is read with the surrounding content; keep the label meaningful without its color.
Tone is never the only signal: the label carries the meaning, and every tone keeps readable text contrast.
Rendered as a link through asChild, it shows a visible focus ring.
